description: This source file defines the SplashActivity class, which displays a splash screen for approximately three seconds before navigating to the HomeActivity. It ensures a splash experience optimized for TV and handles lifecycle correctly to prevent leaks or back navigation.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a splash screen and then navigates to the home screen after a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up splash display, and schedules navigation to HomeActivity after a delay.
